PS3:shovel-knight.d: Shovel Knight is a 2014 platform game developed and published by Yacht Club Games. Players control the eponymous adventurer as he journeys to save his partner, Shield Knight, while fighting an evil Enchantress and a group of knights called the Order of No Quarter. Shovel Knight uses his shovel to attack, dig, and bounce on enemies as he progresses through levels that end with a boss fight. The player can collect treasure to improve Shovel Knight's abilities or purchase Relics which provide helpful effects.

The game was ported by Spike to the PlayStation 3 and PlayStation Portable in September 2009. A version for iOS and Android was released in November 2011. PlayStation 4 and Microsoft Windows versions were released internationally in September 2018.

Cosmic Commuter was Van Ryzin's first game for Activision, after developing a few games for the Apple II computer.

iOS:wheels-of-aurelia.d: Wheels of Aurelia is a 2016 visual novel and adventure video game by Italian studio Santa Ragione. It was released worldwide in September 2016 for Linux, OS X, and Windows; in October 2016 for the PlayStation 4; in November 2016 for the Xbox One; October 2017 for Android and iOS; and November 2017 for the Nintendo Switch. Its story is set in 1978 Italy and tells the story of Lella who drives along the Italian motorway Via Aurelia alongside one or many companions; commenting on issues such as single parenthood, fascism, and the Mafia. The player controls Lella's vehicle from a bird's-eye view and dialogue choices using a branching dialogue system.

iOS:wordfeud.d: Wordfeud is a multiplayer mobile word game developed by Håkon Bertheussen in 2010. In 2011, the game had nearly eight million users worldwide. In 2021, it was reported that the game was being used by adult men for sexual abuse of teenage girls, first investigated by student reporters of Mid Sweden University.

Android:doodle-god.d: Doodle God is a puzzle video game developed by American game developer JoyBits and released for iOS and Adobe Flash. It released around the same time as another similar browser game Little Alchemy, both of which share gameplay with the 1997 MS-DOS game Alchemy.

Android:tower-of-fantasy.d: Tower of Fantasy is a free-to-play action role-playing game developed by Hotta Studio, a Suzhou-based subsidiary of Perfect World. The game is set in a planet called Aida, contaminated with a radioactive energy called Omnium after a cataclysm that nearly wiped out human civilization and mutated the ecology of the planet. The player plays a wanderer that explores a futuristic planet and fights aliens and hostile forces as they advance through the story.
